title: Certification and Recertification in Welfare Programs: What Happens When Automation Goes Wrong?
title_zh: 福利项目中的认证与再认证：自动化出错时会发生什么？
authors: Wu, Derek, Meyer, Bruce D.
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the impacts of administrative burdens across multiple welfare programs and application stages via an increasingly widespread phenomenon: the automation of caseworker assistance. Leveraging a natural experiment phased in across Indiana’s counties and administrative records for 3 million recipients, we find that SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid enrollments fell by 15%, 24%, and 4% after automation. Heterogeneous declines are attributable to cross-program differences in recertification costs. Needier individuals exited while less needy individuals were screened out at entry, potentially reconciling some conflicting results in the literature and best understood through a dynamic selection model of certification and recertification.
abstract_zh: 本文通过日益普遍的行政自动化现象，研究跨多个福利项目及申请阶段的行政负担影响。利用印第安纳州各县分阶段实施的自然实验及300万受助者的行政记录，我们发现自动化后，SNAP、TANF和Medicaid的注册人数分别下降了15%、24%和4%。异质性下降可归因于不同项目在重新认证成本上的差异。需求更迫切的个体退出，而需求较低的个体在进入阶段被筛选排除，这一发现可能调和了文献中部分相互矛盾的结果，并通过认证与重新认证的动态选择模型得以最佳解释。

title: Oil Prices, Monetary Policy and Inflation Surges
title_zh: 油价、货币政策与通胀飙升
authors: Gagliardone, Luca, Gertler, Mark
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a simple quantitative New Keynesian model aimed at analyzing how the reaction of monetary policy contributed to the recent rise and fall in inflation. The model includes several shocks but features oil price shocks for two reasons: (i) energy prices have been among the central factors in discussions about the surge; (ii) we can use identified oil shocks along with monetary shocks to estimate and discipline the model. We then employ the estimated framework to recover shocks without targeting inflation. Both the oil shocks and the shocks to policy accommodation played important roles in the inflation rise.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约的定量新凯恩斯模型，旨在分析货币政策反应如何助推近期通胀的涨落。该模型包含多种冲击，但特别引入油价冲击，原因有二：（i）能源价格一直是通胀飙升讨论中的核心因素；（ii）我们可利用已识别的石油冲击与货币冲击对模型进行估计和约束。随后，我们运用该估计框架在不以通胀为目标的情况下反推各类冲击。研究显示，石油冲击与政策宽松冲击均在通胀上升过程中发挥了重要作用。

title: The Productivity of Professions: Evidence from the Emergency Department
title_zh: 职业的生产力：来自急诊科的证据
authors: Chan, David, Chen, Yiqun
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the productivity of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physicians, two professions performing overlapping tasks but with starkly different backgrounds, training, and pay. Using quasi-experimental variation in patient assignment to NPs versus physicians in Veterans Health Administration emergency departments, we find that, on average, NPs use more resources and exhibit a higher 30-day preventable hospitalization rate than physicians. However, the NP-physician performance difference varies by case complexity and severity. Importantly, even larger productivity variation exists within each profession, leading to substantial overlap between the productivity distributions of the two professions; NPs outperform physicians in 38 percent of random pairs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了执业护士与医生这两类职业的生产力差异。二者虽承担重叠性工作任务，但背景、培训经历及薪酬水平存在显著差异。利用退伍军人健康管理局急诊科患者随机分配至执业护士或医生的准实验变异，我们发现：平均而言，执业护士消耗更多医疗资源，且30天内可预防住院率高于医生。然而，执业护士与医生的绩效差异随病例复杂程度和严重程度而变化。值得注意的是，两类职业内部的生产力差异更为显著，导致二者生产力分布存在大量重叠——在38%的随机配对中，执业护士的表现优于医生。

title: The Fragility of Semi-Liquid Private Credit Funds
title_zh: 半流动性私募信贷基金的脆弱性
authors: Chuck Fang, Itay Goldstein, Yao Zeng
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, which have expanded rapidly and now manage over $300 billion in assets. These funds perform liquidity transformation by holding far more illiquid loans than traditional loan mutual funds while allowing investors to redeem at NAV through quarterly repurchase offers, typically capped at 5% of shares outstanding. We show that cash buffers and contractual loan repayments are insufficient to fund repeated 5% quarterly redemptions; inflows decline precisely when outflows rise; and net outflows are met with sales of illiquid loans, external borrowing, and delayed payments through repurchases payable. As a result, strategic complementarity arises, because redemptions impose liquidation and leverage costs on the remaining investors. We show that loan liquidation, leverage increase, and NAV inflation play an important role in amplifying the current episodes of run-like redemptions. Overall, our evidence suggests that quarterly gates and redemption caps do not eliminate run-like fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, raising cautions about expanding retail access to private credit markets.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了半流动性私募信贷基金的脆弱性。这类基金近年来迅速扩张，目前管理资产规模已超过3000亿美元。这些基金通过持有远多于传统贷款共同基金的流动性较差的贷款来实现流动性转换，同时允许投资者通过季度回购要约（通常上限为流通份额的5%）按资产净值赎回。我们证明，现金缓冲和合同约定的贷款偿还不足以应对持续5%的季度赎回；资金流入恰恰在流出上升时减少；净流出通过出售流动性较差的贷款、外部借款以及通过应付回购延迟支付来应对。因此，战略互补性出现，因为赎回对剩余投资者施加了清算和杠杆成本。我们表明，贷款清算、杠杆增加和资产净值膨胀在当前类似挤兑的赎回事件放大中发挥了重要作用。总体而言，我们的证据表明，季度赎回门槛和赎回上限并未消除半流动性私募信贷基金中类似挤兑的脆弱性，这为扩大零售投资者进入私募信贷市场敲响了警钟。

title: Governance and Management of Autonomous Organizations
title_zh: 自治组织的治理与管理
authors: Daniel Ferreira, Jin Li, Daniel Ferreira; Jin Li
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: An organization is autonomous if it has the right or power of self-government. Self-government implies that autonomous organizations cannot rely on outside parties for contract enforcement; all contracts must be relational or self-executing. We present a model in which an autonomous organization commits to a governance structure that allocates managerial power to some members. We show that the organization faces a trilemma: the goals of autonomy, decentralization, and efficiency conflict with one another. Thus, the optimal governance structure of an autonomous organization is centralized. Centralization implies inequality in power and payoffs among members of autonomous organizations.
abstract_zh: 如果一个组织拥有自治权或自我治理的能力，则该组织具有自主性。自我治理意味着自主组织不能依赖外部主体执行契约；所有契约必须是关系型或自我执行的。我们构建了一个模型，其中自主组织承诺采用一种将管理权力分配给部分成员的治理结构。研究表明，该组织面临一个三难困境：自主性、去中心化与效率这三个目标相互冲突。因此，自主组织的最优治理结构是集权化的。集权化意味着自主组织成员之间在权力和收益分配上存在不平等。

title: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
title_zh: 贴现窗口污名能被消除吗？一项实验研究
authors: Olivier Armantier, Charles Holt
abstract: A core responsibility of the Federal Reserve is to ensure financial stability by acting as the lender of last resort through its Discount Window (DW). The DW, however, has not been effective because its usage is stigmatized. In this paper, we use theory and experiments to study how such stigma can be cured. We find that behavioral inertia makes it difficult to fix a stigmatized DW, but adding a new backstop facility can help mitigate stigma. These results are consistent with the Federal Reserve’s experience. (JEL E58, G01, C92)
abstract_zh: 摘要 美联储的一项核心职责是通过贴现窗口（DW）作为最后贷款人，以维护金融稳定。然而，由于使用贴现窗口存在污名化问题，其有效性受到制约。本文通过理论与实验研究，探讨如何消除此类污名。我们发现，行为惯性使得修复污名化的贴现窗口困难重重，但增设新的后备融资工具有助于缓解污名化。这些结论与美联储的实际经验相符。（JEL E58, G01, C92）

title_zh: 巴基斯坦失学儿童在哪里？利用卫星数据和机器学习方法绘制学校可及性地图——以2022年洪水为例
authors: Saif, Umar, Hasan, Amer, Tahir, Ayesha, Geven, Koen Martijn, Ali, Mohsen, Masood, Aliza, Abdul Rahman, Muhammad, Fazili, Sheena
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Drafting in the swim leg of mass-start triathlon transfers a hydrodynamic cost advantage to the bike and run, where it surfaces as a change in relative rank. I use cross-stage rank improvement as a reverse proxy for free-riding and study its determinants in a ten-year panel of athlete × event records centred on 2020, when COVID-19 response policies replaced mass starts with individually staggered starts and mechanically curtailed drafting. A compact two-stage contest model, in which drafting enters the bike–run stage as a multiplicative cost shifter, organises the predictions. Identification combines pooled OLS with athlete and event fixed effects and a sharp regression-discontinuity design at the 2019/2020 cut-off. Free-riding was substantial before 2020, fell sharply in 2020 (a local-linear RDD estimate of about −31 rank places; a local-cubic estimate of about −92), and recovered only partially afterwards. The gains are largest for weaker swimmers and deeper drafting positions, the gender gap is modest, and they rise with swim-group size at an estimated log–log elasticity of about 0.43. The 2020 disruption thus acts as a contraction of the feasible set for free-riding, and its recovery is uneven rather than broad-based.

title: The Role of Economic and Weather Conditions in Farmer Suicide in the United States
title_zh: 美国经济与天气条件对农民自杀的影响
authors: Qi Wu, Pierre Mérel, Richard J. Sexton
abstract: Farmers commit suicide at high rates relative to the general population in the United States and elsewhere. Prior studies on farmer suicide have generally focused on socio‐demographic characteristics of individuals and on method of suicide, but few quantitative analyses have sought to understand the possible role of economic and climatic factors as determinants of suicide among farmers. This study addresses this void. We develop an economic model to show how poor economic outcomes or adverse weather conditions can reduce current‐period utility and diminish expectations of future utility through accumulation of debt and formation of expectations of future economic and climatic conditions, with suicide resulting in extreme cases. Our empirical analysis merges CDC nonpublic vital statistics, PRISM daily weather data, and USDA NASS crop and livestock price data into a county‐year panel to estimate the relationship between weather variables, economic factors, and farmer suicides. Results based upon a Poisson regression model show that long‐term, not transitory, poor economic conditions are associated with higher rates of farmer suicide. Extreme heat is also associated with increased farmer suicide, especially in counties most reliant upon animal agriculture. Precipitation appears to play little role in U.S. farmer suicide.

title: Monetary Policy, Employment Shortfalls, and the Natural Rate Hypothesis
title_zh: 货币政策、就业缺口与自然率假说
authors: MICHAEL T. KILEY
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: Activity shortfalls are more costly than strong activity. I consider optimal monetary policy under discretion with an asymmetric (shortfalls) loss function in a natural rate model. The optimal monetary policy exacerbates shortfalls, owing to the adjustment of expectations implied by the natural rate hypothesis, and leads to an inflationary bias. Mandating a central bank objective with greater symmetry lowers activity shortfalls and inflation bias. The model also implies that an optimal monetary policy does not accommodate fluctuations from aggregate demand shocks. The analysis implies that monetary accommodation of strong economic activity requires justifications other than asymmetric costs of shortfalls.

title: Does Unfairness Hurt Women? The Effects of Losing Unfair Competitions
title_zh: 不公平会伤害女性吗？输掉不公平竞争的影响
authors: Stefano Piasenti, Marica Valente, Roel van Veldhuizen, Gregor Pfeifer
abstract: We study gender differences in the response to losing competitions using an online experiment (N=2,086). We find that both genders reduce tournament entry rates in response to losses that are unequivocally meritocratic. However, when the winner is not necessarily determined by merit—a setting perceived as less fair than the meritocratic tournament—female losers are relatively more discouraged. These results suggest that women are more negatively affected by competitions perceived as unfair than men. Exploratory machine learning analysis indicates that risk preferences, age and sports participation in adolescence are associated with a reduced impact of losing competitions.
